feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 September 2026 9:29pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 16 September 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal systems across the area tonight.


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first tonight, then veering west 5 or 6 later in the night. Little change tomorrow morning and afternoon, although possibly touching 7 in a few places at times.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the east of the area.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at first, becoming more widespread for a time, clearing to isolated showers later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing west or southwest 4 or 5 for a time around dawn on Friday, before backing south or southwest 5 to 7 on Friday morning. Veering west or southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west on Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
